frictions.description: bash .factory/init.sh failed due to Node.js version in WSL being v12.22.7, which doesn't support the optional chaining syntax required by pnpm. WSL environment seems to require Node.js upgrade for init.sh to work correctly.
frictions.resolution: Failed assertion, requires environment fix or script modification.

frictions.resolution: Increased the execution timeout to 180s which allowed the command to finish successfully.
